description: Language-neutral semantic scenarios for the aspirational contract. Labels are symbolic, not Wire DTOs. These are not yet executable implementation conformance claims. Format outcomes include explicit policy/constraint assumptions.

when: Edit displayed Wednesday to Wednesday afternoon using its accepted basis.
Edit the displayed alternative back to Monday.
Resolve wording while leaving placement undecided.
forbid: Four independent copies for two binary decisions

when: Submit resolution guarded by u1 and alternatives a,b.
Attempt to commit the evaluated result.
forbid: Resolve the new contribution using old evidence

given.policy: Both independently created paragraphs are allowed here; this rule orders them Alpha then Beta.

when: Apply the applicable validated rule.
forbid: Treat keeping both as one shared origin

when: Apply the independent-insertion rule to competing moves.
forbid: Duplicate the paragraph solely because Markdown permits repeated text

given.constraints: No duplicate binding named count in this scope.

when: Consider keeping both declarations.

given.constraints: a and b are independent integer fields; preserve this source layout.

when: Apply a key-aware rule.

alternatives:
- id: x
  value: 1
- id: x
  value: 2

when: Consider concatenation without a compatible field resolution.
forbid: Assume YAML alone establishes array identity

when: Reconcile both changes.

allowed: accepted-unresolved if binary decisions can be preserved and projected
expect.retain: all required alternatives or client-owned rejected request

when: Capture both drafts durably.
Publish a separately prepared complete candidate containing only the independent B effect.
Restart, then review A.

expect.B: accepted remotely without waiting for A
expect.replay: B is not republished or overwritten

given.dependencies: none, proven by exact source correspondence

when: Publish the independent region while retaining the ambiguous first-paragraph edit.
forbid: Whole-file lock solely due to a local ambiguous region

when: Attempt to publish the later edit independently without transporting its guards.
forbid: Treat different path strings as proof of independence

given.constraint: The two changes must stay atomic.

when: One component requires review.
forbid: Split this transaction merely to make progress

when: Reconnect.

expect.firstAction: resolve R through exact retry/receipt recovery

forbid: Rewrite R or create duplicate acceptance

when: Download u2.
Crash during materialization.
Restart.

expect.acceptedState: tracked separately from dirty local projection
expect.status: distinguishes locally captured from remotely accepted

forbid: Inject conflict sidecars into authored files

given.held: failed adopted element owned by another working tree

when: Retain adopted evidence and publish own independent work.
Commit an applicable automatic resolution.
Upgrade the rule implementation.
forbid: Reinterpret old decisions with new rules

given.situation: An accepted text decision projects Tuesday and retains hidden Wednesday; the client has the exact accepted basis but no inspection cache.

when: Submit a snapshot changing Tuesday to Tuesday morning.

given.situation: A client has a durable pending edit and receives an accepted-unresolved result.

when: Apply the result, restart, and submit a later edit while inspection is unavailable.

expect.pending: Accepted effects acknowledged normally; newer local edits preserved

forbid: Treating accepted effects as rejected local work
Pausing sync solely because conflicted is true

given.situation: A snapshot has an exact accepted basis but more than one plausible alternative attribution; the authority supports retaining this ambiguity.

when: Submit the ordinary edit without a client-selected alternative.
forbid: Client guessing a merge or resolution
Rejecting solely because supported ambiguity is unresolved

given.situation: Tuesday is projected and Wednesday is hidden in an open decision.

when: Edit the hidden alternative to Thursday without selecting it.
forbid: Skipping semantic effects because projected hashes match

given.situation: One deletion contribution is accepted; a second author independently deleted the same material from the earlier basis.

when: Accept the second contribution, then explicitly undo only the first.

expect.material: remains deleted by the second contribution

forbid: Skipping semantic effects because projected hashes match

given.situation: An ordered request contains a competing replacement followed by an independent edit.

when: Accept the first element as unresolved, then process the second.

expect.second: accepted or merged with prior alternatives preserved

forbid: Skipping semantic effects because projected hashes match

given.situation: An open decision projects the exact text the person chooses as its resolution.

when: Submit a guarded explicit resolution choosing those bytes.
forbid: Skipping semantic effects because projected hashes match

given.situation: Placement and content decisions constrain the same material.

when: Submit their ordinary operations and both guarded resolution declarations in one candidate.

expect.acceptance: both resolutions and effects commit atomically
expect.failure: a failed guard accepts neither decision

given.situation: Choosing a placement leaves every content alternative meaningful and correctly attached.

when: Resolve placement only, preserving the content decision.

expect.content: open with preserved alternatives and identity

given.situation: After review, a new contribution changes the dependency between two decisions.

when: Submit the earlier coupled resolution.

given.situation: The current accepted root equals the reviewed root, but accepted identity advanced.

when: Submit a candidate with ifCurrent naming the earlier accepted state.

expect.retry: an already successful exact replay returns its original result before guard evaluation

given.situation: An unrelated file changes after review; the decision, affected location, selection, alternatives and dependencies remain unchanged.

when: Submit a guarded resolution without ifCurrent.

expect.result: may accept after proving all reviewed evidence unchanged

given.situation: A tree already retains 32 open decisions.

when: Accept another valid representable competing contribution.

expect.result: The 33rd decision is retained; inspection may page without blocking acceptance.

given.situation: Several accepted semantic updates share one root.

when: Receive them in one observation frame with its own cursor.

expect.result: Validate every predecessor ID/root pair; never infer that unchanged bytes make intermediate transitions redundant.

given.situation: A decision depends on a decision listed on a different page at the same accepted state.

when: Fetch that dependency by identity before joint resolution.

expect.result: Preserve the dependency; an absent page-local record never means resolved.

given.situation: A known rule supplies additional rule-specific JSON details.

when: Decode and display supported evidence.

expect.result: Retain or ignore unknown details without turning them into operations, permission grants or implicit resolutions.

when: Durably create a new entry as a snapshot candidate.
Admit an edit from an editor still holding R1.
Attempt to rename the new entry while the authored branches are unresolved; report that structure awaits Canopy, without acknowledging or queuing the rename.
Restart, publish, lose an acceptance response, and retry exactly. After Canopy reconciles all pending work, rename the new entry and retain its dependency.

expect.local: Acknowledged creations and each retained document generation remain readable; structural actions are temporarily unavailable while document edits and publication continue.
expect.publication: Each original source intent and structural candidate remains recoverable with its original dependency.
expect.acceptance: Install Canopy projection and accepted identity even when conflicted.

forbid: Replacing source intent with the latest projection
Losing a creation when a stale editor admits another file
Acknowledging a structural action before durable retention
Inventing source operations from a snapshot
